summary: Our project is an interactive browser-based space mission simulation game that allows users to design, plan, budget, and launch space missions using realistic NASA mission constraints. Players select planets, spacecraft, fuel, power systems, and scientific instruments while managing limited resources. The game helps students understand space exploration, rocket science, and aerospace engineering through interactive learning.
details:
Our project, Space Mission Design Game, is an interactive browser-based simulation designed to help students understand the challenges of planning and managing space missions.

The game allows players to take the role of a Space Mission Director and design their own space missions. Players can select destinations such as the Moon, Mars, Venus, Europa, and Titan. They can choose spacecraft, launch vehicles, fuel, power systems, and scientific instruments while managing limited budgets and resources.

The game simulates important engineering factors such as fuel requirements, spacecraft mass, power consumption, communication, and orbital constraints. Players can test their decisions, identify mission failures, and improve their designs to achieve mission success.

Benefits and Impact:

- Makes space science and engineering easier to understand.
- Encourages creativity, logical thinking, and problem-solving.
- Provides interactive STEM learning for students.
- Helps students understand real-world space mission challenges.
- Creates interest in astronomy and aerospace engineering.

Creativity and Innovation:

The creative aspect of our project is combining space exploration with game-based learning. Instead of only reading about space missions, users can experience mission planning and understand how different engineering decisions affect mission outcomes.

Our team considered mission objectives, available resources, spacecraft requirements, scientific goals, and realistic space exploration challenges while developing this project.

Development Tools:

The project is designed as a browser-based interactive game. It uses the web development technologies and tools selected by our team to create the game interface, interactions, and mission simulation.
